summary: Join our specialized training course on water management in oil and gas operations. Equip yourself with the tools to tackle industry challenges effectively.
lede: Oil and gas water management covers how water is sourced, characterized, treated, reused and disposed of across operations. For engineers, environmental compliance officers, reservoir teams and operations managers, this course addresses the practical task of assessing water streams and selecting suitable management approaches. It covers produced-water quality analysis, treatment options and planning for water reuse or disposal, including assessing the feasibility of zero-liquid-discharge systems.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is essential for professionals responsible for the technical and environmental performance of oil and gas assets.
modules: Industry Context and Water Lifecycle Foundations
Advanced Treatment and Zero Liquid Discharge
Water Reuse in Enhanced Oil Recovery
Digital Water Management and Strategic Integration
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience in oil and gas operations, environmental management, or facilities engineering. A basic understanding of fluid mechanics and general chemistry is required. No prior programming knowledge is needed, though familiarity with Microsoft Excel for data analysis is recommended.
topics: Water & wastewater treatment and utility management
